people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: King David longed to go out to Absalom; for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
translations.bsb: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he had been consoled over Amnon’s death.
translations.kjv: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
translations.asv: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
